name: Daikin ducted system
tagline: Whole-home ducted heating and cooling with a concealed indoor unit and zoning.
summary: Daikin ducted air conditioning combines a concealed indoor unit, a zone controller and a compact outdoor unit to heat and cool the whole home.
The 2024 range covers Premium Inverter, Inverter, Slimline and Bulkhead models from 2.5 kW to 24.0 kW, most using R32 refrigerant.

image.alt: Daikin indoor unit and outdoor unit

highlights.title: Whole-home comfort
highlights.text: The indoor unit is concealed in the ceiling, so it does not compromise the look of your home.

highlights.title: Up to 8 zones
highlights.text: Manage up to 8 zones, switching rooms on or off from the zone controller.

highlights.title: Night Quiet mode
highlights.text: Night Quiet mode reduces outdoor unit noise levels by 4 dBA.

highlights.title: R32 refrigerant
highlights.text: R32 models use a refrigerant with a substantially lower global warming potential than R410A.

highlights.title: Australian made
highlights.text: Premium Inverter, Inverter and Bulkhead indoor units are designed and manufactured in Sydney.

highlights.title: Airbase app control
highlights.text: The optional Airbase adaptor lets you control the system from a smartphone or tablet.
